children: may test a resistance zone of $86.14-$86.58 per barrel, with a good chance of breaking above it and rising towards $87.28.

A channel technique suggests the target of $87.28, as the market has climbed above the middle channel. A projection analysis on the wave c from $80.17 indicates a similar target range of $87.28-$87.99, as it has travelled above the 161.8% projection level of $85.

A correction from the current level may be limited to a support zone of $84.30-$85. On the daily chart, the market has cleared a resistance zone of $83.41-$84.35. It would rise towards the next zone of $88.57-$90.52.
The rise looks like a bounce against the downtrend from $110.48, which has been riding on a wave C, the third wave of a three-wave cycle from $117.63.
This wave appears too short to complete, compared to the preceding wave A that ended at $67.04.
